schema.item.family: ECreatureFamilyId name; omit when every family can buy it
schema.item.manaPerSecond: flat income while placed (room) or owned (upgrade)
schema.item.manaPerAdventurerPerSecond: income per adventurer inside the dungeon
schema.item.requires: item id that must be owned first (upgrades)
schema.group.implementationStatus: design_only groups are documented but not loaded into the shop

items.name: Dig
items.role: Clear solid rock to carved walkable tile; required before placing rooms and traps.
items.visualDescription: No placed prop—terrain change only. Cleared blocks read as chiseled stone floor with pick marks; invalid dig preview shows shrunken red-tinted ghost cube on rock.

items.name: Mana Well
items.role: Permanent +0.5 mana per second per well; stacks with core trickle and intruder presence income.
items.visualDescription: Single-block shaft or basin in the floor with slow upward-drifting particles (blue-purple). Theme variants: Gothic—iron grate over glowing fluid; Goblin—leaky pipe and green runoff; Fungal—bioluminescent pool; Sunken—flooded niche with refracted light.

items.name: Ley Line Tap
items.role: Permanent +1.2 mana per second; denser than a Mana Well for the same floor space.
items.visualDescription: Floor tile split by a hairline crack of raw mana; a copper or bone spike driven into it with a slow pulse travelling up the shaft.

items.name: Mana Crystal Cluster
items.role: 2×2 room: permanent +3.0 mana per second. Best income per mana spent, but needs a cleared 2×2 footprint.
items.visualDescription: Cluster of waist-high crystals matching the core's colour, growing from a cracked floor; soft volumetric glow and occasional spark arcing between tips.

items.name: Siphon Totem
items.role: +0.25 mana per second for every adventurer inside the dungeon (stacks per totem). Pays off when mazes keep parties wandering.
items.visualDescription: Carved totem pole with an open mouth at the top; faint threads of light drift toward it from any adventurer in the dungeon.

items.name: Core Attunement I
items.role: Permanent +0.4 mana per second to the core's own trickle. No placement needed.
items.visualDescription: Core crystal gains a second inner band of light; pulse rate increases slightly.

items.name: Core Attunement II
items.role: Permanent +0.6 mana per second to the core's own trickle. Requires Core Attunement I.
items.visualDescription: Thin mana cables from the core spread along the chamber floor seams and glow in time with the pulse.

items.name: Core Attunement III
items.role: Permanent +1.0 mana per second to the core's own trickle. Requires Core Attunement II.
items.visualDescription: Core hovers higher with orbiting shards; the whole chamber picks up a faint ambient glow.

items.name: Crypt
items.role: Monster spawn room for Undead; sources Skeleton and Ghoul defenders.
items.visualDescription: 2×2×1 footprint (starter spawner). Stone sarcophagi, wall niches with skulls, cold mist at floor; faint green glow from slab seams.

items.name: War Pens
items.role: Monster spawn room for Orcs; sources Orc Grunt defenders.
items.visualDescription: 2×2×1 wooden stake pens, bone totems, weapon racks, mud and straw floor; torch or brazier smoke.

items.name: Nest Cluster
items.role: Monster spawn room for Spiders; sources Skitterling defenders.
items.visualDescription: 2×2×1 webbed alcoves, egg sacs on ceiling corners, glossy web strands catching point light; occasional skitter shadow in depth.

items.name: Glamour Grove
items.role: Monster spawn room for Evil Fairies; sources Mischief Sprite defenders.
items.visualDescription: 2×2×1 twisted miniature trees or mushroom rings, glitter dust motes, oversaturated fairy lights; pretty surface hiding thorns and teeth in bark.

items.name: Grave Grasp
items.role: Single-block trap: on trigger, grants +10 mana (Undead economy trap).
items.visualDescription: Floor tile with cracked grave slab; on arm, skeletal hands breach upward with dirt clods and short-lived green soul wisps.

items.name: Spike Barricade
items.role: Single-block trap: 12 damage to adventurer; +8 mana if kill.
items.visualDescription: Retractable floor spikes or hinged log barricade with iron spikes; blood-friendly rust, Orc clan paint on wood.

items.name: Web Snare
items.role: Single-block trap: applies Slow, 4 damage; +8 mana if kill.
items.visualDescription: Nearly invisible trip web at ankle height; on trigger, net collapses with sticky strands and a brief spider silhouette on the wall.

items.name: Pixie Dust Cloud
items.role: Single-block trap: warps adventurer to surface entry, 2 damage; +8 mana if kill.
items.visualDescription: Pressure plate disguised with flower petals; puff of pink-gold dust and spiral teleport VFX; disorienting afterimage at destination.

items.name: Coin Pile
items.role: Cheap lure; low dungeon-point value; draws pathing toward corridor bait.
items.visualDescription: Small scatter of gold coins on floor, one glinting coin spinning; no container.

items.name: Chest (Common)
items.role: Standard treasure lure; moderate dungeon points when looted or recovered.
items.visualDescription: Wooden chest with iron bands; theme trim (Gothic iron roses, goblin nails, fungal moss, barnacled sunken wood).

items.name: Chest (Locked)
items.role: Strong lure; adventurer spends extra time at tile—pairs with traps.
items.visualDescription: Heavier chest with visible padlock and keyhole; subtle shake animation when targeted.

items.name: Gem Shrine
items.role: High-priority lure for AI; strong dungeon points.
items.visualDescription: Pedestal with single large gem under a narrow spotlight cone; faint hum and lens flare.

items.name: Relic Pedestal
items.role: Top-tier lure; highest dungeon points; adventurers prefer over common chests.
items.visualDescription: Stone or marble pedestal holding skull, idol, or sword; protective rope of faint magical runes.

items.name: False Chest
items.role: Bait that triggers trap logic or surprise damage instead of reward.
items.visualDescription: Chest slightly off-proportions (hinge wrong, tongue teeth on seam); opens to maw or poison puff.

items.name: Gold Statue
items.role: Large footprint lure; pulls parties off main path.
items.visualDescription: 2-block-tall gilded figure (hero, beast, or core mockery); tarnish in recesses, one eye catching light.

items.name: Buried Hoard
items.role: Requires adjacent dig; weaker early bait for side tunnels.
items.visualDescription: Half-buried crate or urn in rock face; coins spilling from crack after placement.

items.name: Cursed Treasury
items.role: Lure plus debuff on taker (slow or max HP reduction)—risk/reward for player.
items.visualDescription: Ornate coffer wreathed in dark smoke or fairy glamour; violet or sickly green rim light.

items.name: Tribute Altar
items.role: Converts looted treasure into mana over time instead of raw dungeon points.
items.visualDescription: Low altar with offering bowl; coins and trinkets dissolve into upward mana stream when active.

notInShop.name: Core Chamber
notInShop.role: Run start; lose condition if destroyed—not player purchasable.
notInShop.visualDescription: Central heart of the dungeon: pulsing core crystal or heart-in-cage, cables of mana to surrounding rock.
